name: Pla-Mor Bar & Grill
operating_status: Operating — no closure signal in any current listing (Restaurantji, Apple Maps, Waze, Google).

sources.menu_prices: Photographs of their own printed menu, marked ©US Foods Menu 2026 (7710005) and SINCE 1966 — research/guru-menu-1.jpg + guru-menu-2.jpg in versions/astra-draft-0905. All 56 names, descriptions and prices transcribed from those two images.
sources.daily_specials: harvest-0906/g52.jpg — the 'Daily Specials' page photographed inside their black menu binder ('Dinner specials start at 4:00'). Day + dish + wording only; the prices on that sheet belong to the older binder menu (harvest-0906/g46.jpg, g64.jpg — $8.25 hamburger) which the 2026 menu supersedes, so no special price is shown on the page.
sources.hours: Restaurantji structured data for this listing (Mo-Th 11:00-24:00, Fr-Sa 11:00-2:00, Su 11:00-22:00), matched by Apple Maps and Waze.
sources.rating: Restaurantji aggregateRating 4.5 across 250 ratings (ratingValue/ratingCount in the page's JSON-LD).
sources.award: harvest-0906/g1.jpg — the banner bolted to their own wall: 'BEST DIVE BAR / PLA-MOR BAR AND GRILL / VOTED BEST OF WESTERN WASHINGTON IN THE ANNUAL VIEWERS POLL / K5 Evening'. Quoted verbatim.
sources.since_1966: Printed under the wordmark on the front of their own 2026 menu: SINCE 1966.
sources.wordmark: images/logo.png — cropped and keyed off the header band of their own printed menu (guru-menu-2.jpg). Never redrawn.
sources.piranha: images/piranha.png — the engraving printed on their own menu, cropped and keyed off guru-menu-1.jpg.
sources.bar_top_tokens: harvest-0906/g54.jpg — tokens read off the photograph: SKI-INN Enumclaw Wa. · ENUMCLAW SALOON, Enumclaw Wa. 825-2331 · HAGER'S TAVERN 418 N.W. 65th St. 782-3256 · MAPLE VALLEY TAVERN · SNO-VALLEY EAGLES #3529 · SANDBAGGER TAVERN · Yardarm PUB & BROILER, Des Moines WA.
sources.photos: harvest-0906/ (64 Google photos pulled 2026-09-06). Used: g1 hero, g61 hero-portrait, g13/g11/g21 dish strip, g38/g30/g60/g43/g62 the room, g54 story. Every one same-business checked; no identifiable customer face on the page.

review_status: No named, dated review quote could be sourced for this listing — none invented. The proof section carries the K5 Evening award verbatim and the rating aggregate instead.
ask_client: Current daily-special prices (the photographed sheet predates the 2026 menu)
Kitchen closing time vs bar closing time
The 1966 founding story — the DePasquale family / Fred DePasquale / the $24,000 purchase could not be corroborated from any source in hand, so none of it is on the page
Whether the KING 5 Evening 'Best Dive Bar' win is a repeat award, and which year(s)
What's actually in the fish tank (regulars say piranha; the photograph shows an armoured catfish)
Photo permission before launch — every image is an uncleared Google-listing asset
An email address for the contact form to deliver to
